I've implemented the version pinning feature for registry templates. Here's a summary of the changes:

## `sdk/go/common/registry/resolve.go`

Added **`ResolveTemplateFromName(ctx, reg, name, version)`** mirroring the existing `ResolvePackageFromName`:
- **3 parts** (`source/publisher/name`): calls `GetTemplate` directly with the provided version; returns whatever error `GetTemplate` gives (so `errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound)` works on a not-found).
- **2 parts** (`publisher/name`): tries `source="private"` first, then falls back to `source="pulumi"` on `ErrNotFound`; returns an `ErrNotFound`-wrapped error (`"could not resolve …"`) if neither has it.
- **1 part** (`name`): calls `ListTemplates(ListTemplatesOptions{Name: name})` to discover source/publisher (preferring a `private` match), then — if a version is given — fetches it via `GetTemplate`. A versioned miss returns a message containing `version <X.Y.Z> was not found`.
- **4+ parts**: returns `InvalidIdentifierError` (detectable via `errors.As`).

Also added the unexported `templateVersionMismatchError` type that produces the `"… version X was not found"` message and wraps `ErrNotFound`.

## `pkg/cmd/pulumi/templates/cloud.go`

- Extracted the URL-parsing logic out of `NewTemplateMatcher` into a shared **`parseTemplateURL`** helper (same behavior for all forms and error cases).
- `getRegistryTemplates` now detects an `@version` suffix and, when present, routes to the new **`getVersionedRegistryTemplate`** instead of the list-and-match path.
- `getVersionedRegistryTemplate` resolves via `registry.ResolveTemplateFromName` (calling `GetTemplate` under the hood), and:
  - on a registry not-found, emits `version 'X.Y.Z' not found` (single quotes),
  - on a VCS-backed result, emits an error containing both `VCS-backed` and `does not support specific versions`.

The `registryTemplate` type already satisfied the `Name()` / `DisplayName()` (`name [publisher]`) / `Description()` requirements, and the `Registry` interface / `ListTemplatesOptions.Name` were already in place.

**Note:** For the name-only-with-version form, resolution necessarily uses `ListTemplates` once to discover the source/publisher before calling `GetTemplate` with the version (there's no other way to obtain coordinates from a bare name) — the versioned fetch itself always goes through `GetTemplate`.
